comment: I'd recommend it more if I could pause my membership when I travel instead of cancelling and rejoining.
Instructors are brilliant and the classes are the right length.
Offline downloads. I travel every week and the app is useless on planes.
The billing is confusing. I didn't know my trial had turned into a paid plan until I saw my bank statement.
Need a family plan. Paying for two accounts in one house feels wrong.
For a team plan we need an admin dashboard to manage seats and see who is actually using it.
Great app. Apple Watch heart rate would make it perfect.
Crashes on Android all the time, especially when casting. Really frustrating when you're mid-workout.
Let me filter by equipment! I don't own a kettlebell.
I was going to cancel for the summer but I'd rather pause it. Please add a pause option.
Absolutely love it, the variety of classes is amazing.
We need consolidated invoices for our team plan, finance keeps chasing me for receipts.
